Add a GPU Text / Symbol Label Layer (add_labels)

Source: R/map.R
add_labels.Rd

Renders crisp halo-outlined text labels anchored to sf points, polygon centroids, or data.frame coordinates.

Usage

add_labels(
  map,
  data = NULL,
  text,
  lon = NULL,
  lat = NULL,
  size = 12,
  color = "#f8fafc",
  halo_color = "#0f172a",
  id = NULL,
  group = NULL
)

Arguments

map

A gexplore widget or gexplore_proxy.

data

An sf, sfc, or data.frame object.

text

Formula (~name), column name string, or character vector of label texts.

lon

Optional longitude column name or formula (~lon).

lat

Optional latitude column name or formula (~lat).

size

Font size in pixels (default 12).

color

Text color (default "#f8fafc").

halo_color

Halo outline color for contrast (default "#0f172a").

id

Layer ID.

group

Layer group name.
